messages:
Olivia Park: Heads-up  internal transfer request from APAC -> US for Sr Backend Eng. Candidate verbally accepted but asks US start on 2025-06-15. Proposed comp to match local market: base increase to $198k (US band max $190k) + request to accelerate 6 months of RSU vesting as retention. Also requests benefits continuity with no gap.

Marcus Lee: Because it's internal headcount no net HC change, but this exceeds band. Need comp exception routing. Please attach compsheet and business justification.

Olivia Park: Uploaded compsheet and hiring note: https://redwood-internal/offers/2387654321. Business case: critical infra feature delivery and high domain knowledge; risk of losing to competitor if we don't match.

Rowan Patel: Comp Committee guidance: >band requires VP People sign-off. Accelerating RSUs triggers tax and legal review; unusual for internal moves. Suggest cash retention instead to avoid tax complications.

Evelyn Brooks: Finance: we can fund a one-time retention payment up to $12k from Retention-POOL (GL RET-6002). Recommending option A: keep base at band ($190k) + $12k one-time cash + benefits carryover assistance. Option B (base to $198k + RSU acceleration) needs VP People + CFO approval and will increase run-rate.

Olivia Park: Candidate preference is Option B but would accept A if benefits carryover guaranteed. Start date contingent on confirmation by 2025-06-10 EOD.

Rowan Patel: Legal note: RSU acceleration for internal transfers is complex. With acceleration, we must update award agreement and payroll will need to withhold taxes on vesting amount. For APAC->US tax residency changes, candidate could face double taxation unless we do cash instead.

offer-approvals-bot: Request 2387654321 received and routed to: Comp Committee, VP People, Finance, Legal, Benefits Ops. Expedited review requested. ETA: 48 hours.

Marcus Lee: Can hiring mgr confirm if relocation stipend is required? If we can add relocation instead of RSU acceleration it may be cleaner.

Olivia Park: Candidate asked for relocation funds for move assistance but said cash retention or RSU acceleration are both options. Relocation estimate ~$4k.

Evelyn Brooks: Finance POV: prefer Option A (band + $12k cash + $4k relocation). That keeps recurring comp within band and uses retention pool for one-time items. We'll need a signed approval for cash payment terms and repayment clause if they leave within 12 months.

Rowan Patel: Benefits Ops: benefits can't literally "carry" across regions, but we can aim for no gap by coordinating enrollment effective date with US payroll start; may require short-term bridging for any service discrepancies. Will coordinate enroll date if payroll setup completed prior to start.

Marcus Lee: VP People sign-off required for any >band base change (Option B). @Rowan please escalate to VP People and Comp Chair. Candidate deadline tight.

Rowan Patel: Escalated to VP People and Comp Chair. Also added tax advisory request for RSU acceleration implications.

Olivia Park: Thanks. I'll hold candidate and ask them to pause acceptance until 6/10 EOD. Will update thread with final decision. :hourglass: 

Evelyn Brooks: Finance will prepare PO and journal lines if Option A approved: RET-6002 for cash, RELOC-3101 for relocation.

offer-approvals-bot: Update: Comp Committee meeting scheduled in 24 hours. Noted expedited.

Olivia Park: Appreciated  will follow up asap.
